title: Obadiah
author: Obadiah.
date: Date uncertain, likely connected with Edom's hostility toward Jerusalem.
historicalSetting: Obadiah announces judgment on Edom's pride and hope for God's kingdom.
christFocus: Obadiah points to Christ by anticipating the triumph of God's kingdom and deliverance for His people.
outline: The day of the Lord and kingdom hope — Obadiah 15-21
